title: LG C3/C4: Best motion settings to reduce judder vs stutter
audience: LG C3/C4 owners seeing judder in films or smearing in sports.

quick.fast: Movies: Cinematic Movement; Sports: User Selection (De-blur 10).
quick.deeper: Fine-tune de-judder 0-1 for films; 2-3 for sports; optional OLED Motion Low.

steps: Movies: Cinematic Movement or User Selection (de-judder 0-1, de-blur 8).
Real Cinema: On; Noise Reduction: Off on clean sources.
why: De-blur helps high-fps sports; low de-judder preserves 24p film cadence.
